specification: ShopMaster Phoenix Stage3 field-level native PostgreSQL mapping
approved_direction: Project-owner instruction: native arrays, json, uuid; no scalar-text substitutes

policies.nullability: Unknown source attributes stay explicit; no invented NOT NULL or default substitution.
policies.array_shape: One dimension, printed N for each non-NULL array; preserve source origin and order. Lower bounds await source evidence.
policies.financial: Unconstrained numeric[] with no invented p,s or floating-point conversion. Missing source precision affects validation/rounding parity, not exact storage selection.
policies.defaults: Record only complete printed vectors; do not complete absent defaults or clipped UUID annotations.
policies.time: time[] without timezone/fractional typmod transformations. Do not infer storage precision solely from masks.
policies.json: json only; preserve raw representation where supported, no jsonb normalization or invented serialization.
policies.uuid: uuid; retain original identity values, no generator.
policies.deployment: This JSON is a specification, not an executable --type-map configuration. All native targets remain unsupported by the current converter.

array_semantics.ordering: Preserve source order and logical subscript identity; no sorting, compaction or silent reindexing.
array_semantics.emptyArrayPolicy: With N>0, a non-NULL empty array fails fixed shape. Do not replace it with NULL or auto-fill defaults; report the distinction pending an authoritative source rule.
array_semantics.nullElementPolicy: Keep NULL slots and positions; source allowance is not printed. Do not replace NULL by zero/false/empty string.

required_constraints_or_validation.requirement: Every non-NULL array must have exactly one dimension and 7 elements.
required_constraints_or_validation.enforcement: Database validation preferred plus application/import checks; type declaration dimensions alone are insufficient.

required_constraints_or_validation.requirement: Preserve source origin and upper bound origin+N-1. Neither 0 nor 1 is assumed from the supplied declaration.

required_constraints_or_validation.enforcement: Native element type enforces signed range.

default_handling.notes: Positions preserve printed order. Numeric values stay decimal strings in this specification. No defaults have been implemented.

null_handling.policy: Preserve source nullness; no NULL-to-default/zero/empty substitution. Do not invent NOT NULL.
